import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_12/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_12/test_1.csv"
    
    # Load source tables
    df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)
    
    # Inspect schemas:
    # df0 columns: ['Athlete', 'Age', 'Year', 'Closing Ceremony Date', 'Gold Medals', 'Silver Medals', 'Bronze Medals', 'Total Medals']
    # df1 columns: ['Athlete', 'Country']
    
    # Join df0 and df1 on 'Athlete' to add 'Country' to df0
    # Since df1 has many athletes, and df0 athletes are a subset, a left join on df0 is appropriate
    df_merged = pd.merge(df0, df1, on='Athlete', how='left')
    
    # Target schema:
    # ['Athlete': string, 'Age': float, 'Year': integer, 'Closing Ceremony Date': string,
    #  'Gold Medals': integer, 'Silver Medals': integer, 'Bronze Medals': integer,
    #  'Total Medals': integer, 'Country': string]
    
    # Ensure correct dtypes:
    # Age: float
    df_merged['Age'] = pd.to_numeric(df_merged['Age'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    # Year: integer
    df_merged['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df_merged['Year'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
    # Gold Medals, Silver Medals, Bronze Medals, Total Medals: integer
    for col in ['Gold Medals', 'Silver Medals', 'Bronze Medals', 'Total Medals']:
        df_merged[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_merged[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
    # Athlete and Country: string
    df_merged['Athlete'] = df_merged['Athlete'].astype(str)
    df_merged['Country'] = df_merged['Country'].astype(str)
    # Closing Ceremony Date: string (keep as is)
    df_merged['Closing Ceremony Date'] = df_merged['Closing Ceremony Date'].astype(str)
    
    # Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
    target_columns = ['Athlete', 'Age', 'Year', 'Closing Ceremony Date',
                      'Gold Medals', 'Silver Medals', 'Bronze Medals', 'Total Medals', 'Country']
    df_target = df_merged[target_columns]
    
    # Write to target CSV
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_12/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
